stories.title: Cincinnati Finals Results — Fils Claims First Masters 1000, Gauff Wins Second Cincinnati Title — TIER 1

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Arthur Fils wins his first Masters 1000 title — and France's first since Tsonga. Coco Gauff claims her 2nd Cincinnati crown. A Sunday to remember at the Cincinnati Open.

#Tennis #CincinnatiOpen #ATPTour #WTATennis

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Arthur Fils, 22, defeats Frances Tiafoe 6-3, 1-6, 6-0 to become the youngest-ever French Masters 1000 champion. France's first M1000 title since Tsonga. Fils is 10-0 in three-set matches in 2026.

#Tennis #CincinnatiOpen #ATPTour #Fils

article.headline: Fils and Gauff Win Cincinnati: France's First Masters 1000 in 12 Years, Gauff's Second Crown
